successors.name: Cyrenaica
successors.text: the Pentapolis (Cyrene, Apollonia, Taucheira, Euesperides, Barce) that the cyrenaica dossier begins in 332 with Alexander's tribute

ledger.x: 631: Theran settlers under Battus I found Cyrene.
525: the cities of the Pentapolis appear as one unit.
332: Alexander takes tribute and the Persian dependency ends.
332: the Pentapolis passes to the cyrenaica dossier.

wars.name: Egyptian expedition against Cyrene (Battle of Irasa)
wars.outcome: Cyrene victory: Libyan rivals 'appealed to Egypt for help around 570 BC' and the pharaoh Apries 'was decisively defeated at the Battle of Irasa'.

wars.name: Battle of Leuco
wars.outcome: Arcesilaus II of Cyrene was killed by the Barcans and Libyans at Leuco around 550 BC; Barca stayed separate until the Persian sack of 515.

wars.name: Persian siege of Barca
wars.outcome: Aryandes, governor of Egypt, 'besieged and sacked Barca in 515 BC' at the call of Pheretime, mother of the murdered Arcesilaus III; Darius I settled some captives in Bactria.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for Cyrene or the Pentapolis; the shapes are the polis radius and the later Cliopatria outline of the five cities.
